bio.CareerHighlightsSingles:
Reached career-high rankings in singles and doubles in 2025: No.19 in doubles (October 20) and No.168 in singles (November 10)

Won two doubles titles in 2025 at Bad Homburg and Adelaide (both w/Panova), also reached three finals at Monterrey, Cincinnati (both w/Panova) and Strasbourg (w/Melichar-Martinez)

Registered first Tour-level singles win on WTA 1000 main draw debut at Montreal in 2025 (as a qualifier, d. Putintseva to register first Top 50 career-win). Also played 1r at Beijing, Ningbo, Guangzhou and 2r at Jiujiang

2024 highlights include title runs in doubles at Jiujiang (w/Uchijima) and Monterrey (w/Niculescu), also reached the doubles finals at Hua Hin and Hobart (both w/Jiang)

In 2023 won first Tour-level doubles title at Guangzhou (w/Jiang) and reached the final at Ningbo (w/Jiang)

Played predominantly on the ITF circuit between 2019-2023, now owns 7 ITF singles titles and 17 ITF doubles titles

Reached 2nd WTA doubles final at Anning 125 in 2018, also qualified for singles main draw at Guangzhou (l. Saisai Zheng in 1r)

Played first WTA Tour-level event in 2017 at Zhengzhou as a qualifier (l. Hozumi in 1r). Reached first WTA 125 doubles final at Dalian (w/Ye)

In 2016 won first singles ITF title at Hua Hin $10k and first ITF doubles title at Anning $10k

Played first ITF singles tournament in 2015 at Anning $10k as a qualifier and reached 2r
bio.CurrentYearDetail: Made Grand Slam main draw debut at Roland Garros (as qualifier, l. Kessler in 1r)
bio.personal:
Trains at Star River Professional Tennis Club in Guangzhou, where Alan Ma, the executive director of the club, helped guide path to professional tennis
Currently coached by Robert Cokan, who is also a member of the club
Self-describes playing style as aggressive
Started playing tennis with cousin, starting by picking up balls when he played
Mother is Li Huanlan, Father is Guo Weidong. They have both worked for Henan Provincial Sports Center
Growing up enjoyed watching Gael Monfils play
Enjoys competing on at any tournament's center court full, especially when the stands are full of spectators
Enjoys playing on Hard court, especially at Indian Wells and Australian Open
Earned Master’s degree in Sports Education from Southwest University in China
In free time enjoys spending time with my dog, study psychology, and try different food
If was not playing tennis, would envision working in a career related to psychology
